chapters.focus: Modernize ordinary address and third-person verbs; use those who in the accepted waiting/reverence verse. Preserve threefold avenging, removing enemies, patient/strength, refusal to acquit with no supplied object, consummation/shaking/cloud-dust, sea/rivers/Bashan/Carmel/Lebanon, past landscape verbs, rulers melted, waiting and reverence separately, advancing flood/darkness, no double vengeance, thorn-vine/stubble, many waters, rod/bonds, carved/cast images and the swift burial clause.

chapters.focus: Modernize ordinary address and third-person verbs; render game as prey at 2:13–14 to keep the lion image clear.
